entries.title: Shipped Canada Economic Opportunity Graph case study
entries.summary: Added a representative architecture scenario for the open CEGS reference implementation, including deterministic scoring and evidence-linked provenance.

entries.title: Extended the opportunity graph with four federal sources
entries.summary: Added Bank of Canada Valet, Open.Canada federal contracts, the federal lobbyist registry, and CMHC housing indicators — each fixture-first, key-free, and provenance-hashed.

entries.title: Connected reconciliation intelligence to the graph
entries.summary: Added an opt-in Canada-COG connector so reconciliation runs can read deterministic project scores alongside financial flows.

entries.title: Isolated the three GPUs onto dedicated inference lanes
entries.summary: Pinned large, medium, and small model traffic to separate cards with health and thermal watchdogs so one workload cannot starve another.

entries.title: Made live ingestion opt-in and never-silent
entries.summary: Learned that a fixture-first default with an explicit live flag keeps builds deterministic while still allowing real upstream fetches under test.

entries.title: Cleared TypeScript 6.0 deprecation failures across the stack
entries.summary: Fixed build-breaking deprecations so the toolchain upgrade landed without touching runtime behaviour.

entries.title: Exported GPU telemetry without a heavyweight agent
entries.summary: Shipped a minimal metrics endpoint that exposes utilisation, memory, temperature, and power for every card.

entries.title: Stopped treating missing values as zero
entries.summary: Killed a class of silent substitutions so unknown observations stay unknown instead of poisoning analytical totals.

entries.title: Released public engagement simulator
entries.summary: Shipped self-serve qualification flow that produces deterministic engagement briefs.

entries.title: Removed non-deterministic copy from CTA stack
entries.summary: Killed language that implied unsupervised autonomy and aligned to governance-first framing.

entries.title: Improved metadata coverage for resource routes
entries.summary: Fixed metadata gaps to prevent SEO drift across new moat pages.

entries.title: Published methodology whitepaper
entries.summary: Shipped a rigorous methodology document clarifying deterministic boundaries and deployment models.

entries.title: Retired duplicated service narrative blocks
entries.summary: Killed repeated messaging that created terminology drift between services and ecosystem pages.

entries.title: Added messaging consistency contract checks
entries.summary: Learned that fail-fast copy checks prevent regressions without slowing static builds.
